review: Builds on a1 (same model family, unrefereed) and block 59 where they agree with my derivation; exact checks: the continuum family law dv/dt = 2(v.grad log ab)v - a^2b^2 grad log a - |v|^2 grad log b at four Pythagorean points, its weak-field form matching the comparator's full first-order law iff alpha = beta = 1, a1's lattice law re-checked at rational sines, block 77's staggered rest energy giving E^2 = a^2m^2 + c^2 sum sin^2 k (integer matrices on 4^3), block 62's frame H[b1] = bH, and the power-mean bond rate b = 1 + O(d^2); the single-walker hop-share line (intercept 1, slope beta) is executed in 2D (floating point, width-converged to about 1-3 percent).
what: DERIVATION, independent attempt 2 of 3: A field of clock rates gives half of the comparator's bending of light: what would a clause for lengths be?. SETTING (blocks 53 and 54; open PRs titled 'ail53: no master clock' and 'ail54: a phase timed by the local clock'; both are SUPPLIED clauses, not adopted; the axioms memo docs/MINIMAL_AXIOMS_2026-06-29.md defines no time metric and no amplitude dynamics). BLOCK 53: every site of Z^3 has a positive tick rate w_x, u = log w; the rate at a site is determined by its six neighbours' rates by one rule, covariant under translations and proper rotations, and scale covariant (only ratios of rates mean anything). ESTABLISHED there: every such rule has the weak-field form u_x = average of u over the six neighbours (no mass term); on a torus only the zero-sum part of a source enters; a record enters as a ratio kappa of its rate to its neighbours' mean, that is as the additive source log kappa (exact superposition; clocks slow near records if kappa < 1); ONE NUMBER, kappa, is left, and the second order of the rule is not fixed ((p - 1) d^2/6 for the power mean of order p). BLOCK 54: one moving record is a two-component amplitude psi_x (the site's qubit as its content; rotations turn the content as a direction); hermitian, rotation-covariant nearest-neighbour generators have the symbol a_0 + 2a sum cos k_j + beta sum sigma_j sin k_j; the walk with the qubit as coin is H = sum_j sigma_j D_j, D_j = (i/2)(T_j - T_j^dagger), energies +-sqrt(sum sin^2 k_j), velocity operator sigma_j (T_j + T_j^dagger)/2, and NO 2x2 matrix anticommutes with it (one walker has no rest energy). CLAUSE: the amplitude at a site advances in that site's own time, giving the generator w H, similar to the hermitian H_w = sqrt(w) H sqrt(w), conserved sum |psi_x|^2/w_x. ESTABLISHED: in a uniform gradient H_w^n T_a = lambda_a^n T_a H_w^n exactly (force = -(energy) x grad u in every state); rays of E = w(x) eps(k) obey dv_j/dt = -w^2 sum_l d_j d_l(eps^2/2) d_l u + 2 (v.grad u) v_j, which for the walk is -w^2 cos(2 k_j) d_j u + 2 (v.grad u) v_j whatever the rest energy; EXECUTED, NOT PROVED: packets follow clouds of rays to 5 parts in 10^4 (line) and 2 parts in 10^3 (three dimensions), and they also drift SIDEWAYS along (gradient) x (motion) by g T/(2k) (measured -0.119 and -0.227 against 0.120 and 0.240), which no ray has. Controls: .claude/science/physics-loops/admissibility-induced-law-20260906/specs/supervisor_control_block54_*.py on the block 54 PR branch. TASK: block 54's clause times phases and says nothing about lengths; a ray at the limiting speed moving across the gradient bends at -w^2 grad u, the same as a body at rest, where the comparator theory gives twice that for light and the same for slow bodies. (a) Show that the energy function E = w sqrt(m^2 + w^2 k^2) (rest energy timed by w, hops timed by w^2) gives -grad u for slow bodies and -2 grad u for transverse rays at the limiting speed, and find the general two-function family E = a(x) sqrt(m^2 + b(x)^2 k^2) with its law of fall. (b) On the lattice: what local object could play the role of b? Candidates to examine, each in the framework's vocabulary: a rate for bonds distinct from the rate for sites; block 53's scale covariance applied to bond rates; the second-order term of block 53's law. For each say whether it is forced, allowed or excluded by block 53's premise that only ratios of rates mean anything. (c) State the executed test that would separate a = b from b = 1 on the clocked walk. No gravitational claim is to be made; the comparator is a comparator. check.py: the ray laws of (a) with exact rational arithmetic at Pythagorean points, in the manner of block 54's runner.  DELIVERABLE, in your unit worktree on ai/probes: probes/work/derive/a-clause-for-lengths/<your worker name>/ATTEMPT.md and check.py. ATTEMPT.md: (1) the exact statement you attempt; (2) numbered steps, each marked PROVED (argument given in full), CHECKED (a finite fact check.py verifies exactly) or ASSUMED; (3) if the route fails, the FIRST step that fails and why: a precise no-go for a route is a result; (4) what would finish it. check.py: exact arithmetic (fractions, integers, sympy) for every finite claim; it prints `SUMMARY: PROVED ...`, `SUMMARY: COUNTEREXAMPLE ...`, `SUMMARY: PARTIAL <what is new and exact>` or `SUMMARY: ROUTE FAILS AT <step>`, and a line `HIT: <the claim>` ONLY when you claim a proof, a counterexample, or a new exact partial result others can build on; a HIT is handed to a worker of another model family to referee line by line, so write for a hostile reader. Rules: definitions come from the notes on the PR branches named above (git fetch origin <branch>; git show origin/<branch>:<note>; find them with gh pr view <n> --json files,headRefName); any outside theorem you use must be re-proved at the scope you use it or listed under ASSUMED; no status words (proved theorems are promoted by the supervisor after the referee). Have your own plan BEFORE reading the prior attempts printed at claim time; then either build on a refereed partial result or take a different route. Run: python3 probes/run_probe.py <task> --worker <name> --model <model> --review "..." --extra "python3 probes/work/derive/a-clause-for-lengths/<name>/check.py"
